problem: Low leave-one-out scores come from symptom or denunciation questions sitting on app-report entries. The medical or complaint answer lives in the other section.
suggestion: Keep first aid, lost-person protocol, lost objects and environmental complaints in their sections. Actions only prepares the local report and says to call 123 when there is signal.

problem: A live fire report is embedded next to dated páramo-fire explanations.
suggestion: Flora keeps the historical fires. Actions keeps the handoff for a fire the visitor is seeing now.

problem: The ficha also says Cisne-Poleka Kasue and Otún need three business days, Quindío-Dulima five, and a November pico y placa under Resolución 1815 of 24 July 2026. Actions names the two Brisas rules and the resolution, and does not copy the hours.
suggestion: booking_fees keeps the 3-day and 5-day lead times; hours_status keeps the plate schedule. Do not merge those entries into actions.

problem: conversation.emergency_limits says a report might not arrive without a connection. The FSM execute string says the report was sent. The tool implementation only stores a local code.
suggestion: The conversation curator should say the report stays on the phone and is not a rescue dispatch. Actions already says the app does not notify rescue.

suggestion: Flora owner replaces that hard negative if the example is retired later.
